sys_hub_flow.description: Business Rule + Subflow and not a Flow trigger: Additional comments is a journal field. Flow trigger conditions on Incident do not offer journal fields, and triggering a Flow on the Journal Entry table would mean opening a platform-wide setting and running on one of the busiest tables in the instance. The recognized ServiceNow pattern is: detect the change declaratively in a Business Rule (its condition builder supports Additional comments changes), and run the integration logic in a reusable Subflow, started asynchronously with the documented sn_fd.FlowAPI.
